goal: Make WO harness par with OO, then better. Build on existing bootstrap files.
acceptance: All infrastructure files enhanced, visual/behavioral gaps documented, performance benchmarks > OO

tasks.title: Enhance diff.js with per-dialog thresholds
tasks.description: Update census/visual/diff.js: add configurable threshold per dialog type (0.01 for small, 0.05 for large). Add function compareDialogScreenshots(name, ooPath, woPath). Commit.

tasks.title: Enhance capture.js with dialog open helpers
tasks.description: Update census/visual/capture.js: add openDialog(name) that clicks ribbon button to open dialog before capture. Add waitForDialog(name) using MutationObserver. Commit.

tasks.title: Complete shortcuts-audit.md with WO status column
tasks.description: Update census/behavioral/shortcuts-audit.md: add WO Status column to each shortcut entry. Values: Implemented, Missing, Partial, Different. Commit.

tasks.title: Add Escape key handlers to all remaining dialogs
tasks.description: In editor.js, search for all dialogs opened with .classList.add('open'). For each without Escape handler, add: dialogEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key==='Escape') dialogEl.classList.remove('open'); });. Commit.

tasks.title: Create 2 missing dialog shells
tasks.description: From census/ledger/missing-dialogs.md, pick mail-merge and macro. Create dialog HTML + CSS files in server/apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/. Add to DIALOG_IDS in editor.js. Commit.

tasks.title: Implement table alternating row colors
tasks.description: Add alternating row color feature for tables. In style.css, add .table tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f5f5f5; }. Add toggle button in ribbon. Commit.

tasks.title: Run and document benchmark results
tasks.description: Use census/performance/benchmark.js to measure current performance. Run runBenchmark() in browser console on staging (:8086). Save results to census/performance/baseline-wo.json. Commit.

tasks.title: Optimize editor.js - use requestAnimationFrame
tasks.description: In editor.js, find DOM updates that aren't time-critical (selection highlighting, scroll position updates). Wrap in requestAnimationFrame(() => {...}). Target: reduce input latency. Commit.

tasks.title: Run parity-check.yml CI workflow manually
tasks.description: Trigger .github/workflows/parity-check.yml via workflow_dispatch. Wait for completion. Document results in census/PARITY-RUN-LOG.md. Commit.

tasks.title: Deploy parity-plus improvements
tasks.description: Build Docker image worldoffice/documentserver:parity-plus. Deploy to prod :8082 and staging :8086. Copy editor.js, style.css, index.html to editor-ui mounts. Verify with curl.
